verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe using Codex CLI to 'explore unfamiliar code, plan a change, edit files' (codex-docs-9), implying autonomous codebase exploration without manual file selection, and agents can delegate to specialized sub-agents to gather findings (codex-docs-13). However, there's no dedicated 'explain codebase' or architecture-mapping feature described, and community evidence focuses on coding/editing performance and reliability issues rather than confirming deep codebase comprehension quality.
